title: The Ghost Light
text: A cold blue light floats ahead in the tunnels, always just out of reach, always just around the next bend. It flickers when you stop. It waits when you hesitate. It has led someone before: there are footprints under it, and they do not come back.

options.label: Follow the blue light, wherever it leads, as others have before.

outcomes.text: It leads to treasure left by whoever followed it last. Of them, you find no sign.
It leads to a drop. After a hard landing at the bottom, you see the light hovering above, waiting.

options.label: Ignore it. Lights that wait for you are never kind.

outcomes.text: It sulks and dims. Somewhere behind you it brightens again, leading something else your way.

options.label: The shrewdest traps it in a jar, before it leads anyone else astray.

outcomes.text: The light never goes out, and it never stops pressing against the glass.
